_doc: Curated docking targets. An entry is usable by the campaign ONLY when verified=true (set by scripts/verify_target_library.py after the native co-crystal ligand redocks with symmetry-corrected RMSD <= 2.0 A AND passes PoseBusters). receptor_pdb + box are filled by the verifier (the prepared apo receptor + co-crystal-ligand box). Human structures are used with conserved-pocket reasoning for the canine HSA <-> human AS thesis.

PIK3CA.notes: PI3Kalpha p110a kinase domain; alpelisib (BYL719) co-crystal. Project history: redock ~1.8A. Box auto from the largest drug-like HET (= alpelisib).

KDR.notes: VEGFR2 (KDR) kinase domain co-crystal. Angiogenesis is central to hemangiosarcoma; toceranib (Palladia) is the clinical canine VEGFR-TKI. Verify the chosen PDB by redock; re-curate if it fails.

MTOR.notes: mTOR kinase domain + ATP-competitive inhibitor co-crystal. NOTE: rapalogs (everolimus) bind allosterically via FKBP and will NOT redock here; pair MTOR with an ATP-competitive mTOR inhibitor, or verify before use.
